description: Turn receipts you have read into an Excel (.xlsx), CSV, Xero or QuickBooks import file, with VAT split into one column per rate. Returns totals per currency and VAT rate, warnings where net + VAT doesn't match the total, and a download link valid for 24 hours. Up to 200 receipts per call.

csvStyle.description: For csv only: standard = comma-separated with dot decimals; european = semicolons with comma decimals (Excel in most EU countries)

format.description: xlsx (Excel), csv, xero (bank statement CSV) or quickbooks (bank upload CSV)

includeLineItems.description: xlsx: add a Line items sheet; csv: one row per line item

receipts.description: The receipts you have read, one entry per receipt (1 to 200). Copy amounts as printed; never guess a VAT rate

category.description: Expense category, e.g. Meals, Travel, Office

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, e.g. EUR, GBP, USD

lineItems.description: The receipt's lines, if you need them in the file (see includeLineItems). Leave out otherwise

description.description: The line as printed, e.g. Cappuccino

price.description: What the line cost (qty × unit price), not the unit price

qty.description: Quantity; 1 if the receipt shows none

subtotal.description: Amount before VAT, if printed. Left out: we derive it from total minus VAT

vat.description: One entry per VAT rate printed on the receipt. Leave out if the receipt shows no VAT

vendor.description: Shop or supplier name as printed

totalsCurrency.description: Also convert every total to this currency at the ECB rate of the receipt date, e.g. EUR

name: build_receipt_spreadsheet
title: Build a receipt spreadsheet
